title: Full-chain intent to reflection conformance with independent final verification

scope.scale: cross-repository native conformance / replay and authority-boundary frontier

ideaContract.purpose: Verify one deterministic logical operation from an explicit intent through canonical ProofPath, an actual CML causal record, durable local/test LiminalDB write and reopen, bounded RINSE reflection, and independent ContractGraph-QA reconstruction.
ideaContract.expectedOutcome: The same logical_operation_id and argument digest survive every stage; exact pinned heads are checked; durable bytes replay after restart; reflection remains non-authorizing; and all declared negative cases fail closed.
invariants: intent is explicit, nonce-bound and argument-digest-bound
the same logical_operation_id travels through every stage
ProofPath native verification is executed at the exact canonical capability commit
CML reconstructs an intact root-first causal chain
LiminalDB storage is separately admitted as local_test_only and survives reopen
same-operation retry is deduplicated without rewriting the first transaction time
RINSE consumes durable bytes read-only and produces ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS / REFLECTION_ONLY
ContractGraph-QA independently recomputes the final result from raw artifacts
missing intent, replay, changed arguments, stale heads, tampering and reflection escalation are rejected
no stage grants execution, mutation or external-effect authority
forbiddenOutcomes: accepting an argument object under a stale digest
using a mutable or stale dependency head as current proof
creating a second durable record after retry
turning RINSE reflection into executable authority
claiming production interoperability or security from this bounded fixture
ideaContract.parentContract: NEO REZONANS system contract v0.1 plus the FCRP-SYSTEM-005 durable and FCRP-SYSTEM-006 reflection boundaries

evidence.claim: The operation has an explicit nonce, canonical argument digest, expected outcome and non-authorizing authority boundary.
The generated SCIG is accepted by the pinned native ProofPath verifier as VALID.
CML reconstructs the deterministic intent -> ProofPath -> CML root-first parent-cause chain with integrity-bound records.
The local/test durable record is reopened byte-for-byte, deduplicates a same-semantic retry and rejects changed evidence under the same operation.
RINSE derives a bounded reflection from the exact durable bytes without mutating source or creating executable handoff authority.
All six declared negative cases are exercised and rejected.
ContractGraph-QA recomputes the chain, native receipt, durable event, RINSE loop and FCRP result from raw artifacts.

past.summary: SYSTEM-005 proved durable ProofPath ingestion and SYSTEM-006 proved bounded durable-to-RINSE reflection, but no single fixture began at an explicit intent and independently reconstructed the complete chain.

present.summary: SYSTEM-007 composes the existing native segments under one logical operation, exact dependency heads, CML parent-cause lineage, restart replay and negative authority tests.

future.summary: Production cross-repository interoperability, distributed transactionality, multi-tenant authorization, and semantic coverage beyond the bounded fixture remain separate gates.

causalPath.statement: A cross-repository proof cannot safely start from ambient context; it needs an explicit intent, nonce and canonical argument digest before any native adapter is invoked.
The prior native segments were individually replayable but did not bind one complete intent-to-reflection operation across all boundaries.
Without one CML parent-cause chain and one logical operation identity, a downstream PASS could be detached from the original intent.
The bounded runner binds intent, native ProofPath, CML, durable LiminalDB state, RINSE reflection and final independent CGQA verification to exact revisions and explicit negative cases.
Evidence, durable storage and reflection remain non-authorizing; execution and mutation authority stay false throughout the proof.

navigation.reason: The missing guarantee is composition across sibling repositories and authority boundaries, not a deeper change inside one repository.

refactor.change: Add one exact-head, native-segment, restart-replay and negative-case conformance workflow driven by a deterministic intent and independently recomputed by ContractGraph-QA.
refactor.expectedEffect: The complete bounded chain becomes replayable without silently converting evidence, persistence or reflection into execution authority.

authorization.authorityBoundary: The workflow may use only repository-local fixtures and an ephemeral local_test_only LiminalDB store. It grants no production write, execution, deployment, merge, financial or external-effect authority.
